field_meanings: Daily OHLC is an interval aggregate, not an official auction execution or guarantee of an executable price.
IEX volume represents a single venue and is not consolidated market volume.
IEX fields can include extended-hours trade conditions as defined by the provider.
finalization_rule: Finalize only after the last interval affecting every included field has ended and the supplied session deadline has passed.
revision_policy: Preserve each raw response; later provider revisions remain separately observable.
